operative_text:
SECTION 2 (HRS 134-2): The issuing authority shall perform an inquiry on an applicant by using the International Justice and Public Safety Network, including the United States Immigration and Customs Enforcement query, the National Crime Information Center, and the National Instant Criminal Background Check System, pursuant to section 846-2.7, and shall inform the Federal Bureau of Investigation's Terrorist Screening Center of the application, before any determination to issue a permit or to deny an application is made.
SECTION 2 (HRS 134-2): Permits to acquire a pistol or revolver shall require a separate application and permit for each transaction.
